items.hypothesis: Increase only geometry Adam multiplier from0.125 to1.0 for dense and routed KS3. Existing terminal diagnostics show coefficient RMS near0.01 at the baseline and proportional changes for0.0625/0.25; test substantially faster geometry adaptation. Keep zero coefficient initialization, raw scale0.75, rank1/width1024, projection rates1.0 and all shared/model-wide settings. This is a learning-rate ablation, not a validation claim from the diagnostic statistics.

Set only geometry Adam multiplier to0.0 so zero spline/warp coefficients remain at initialization while both projection banks learn normally. This isolates the benefit or cost of learned geometry within the same all-KS3 GS32/BF16 implementation, width1024 and fixed backend. It is a fixed-geometry mechanism ablation; even a win would not establish an advantage from learned spline deformation. Retain all KS3 modules, gradients and optimizer state, projection rates1.0 and all shared/model-wide settings.

prerequisite: Complete original-width2816 trial and any frozen three-seed verification first
decision: Distinct configuration-only KS3 ablations using existing numerical kernels; graph warmup and strict training-proxy pruning remain mandatory. No model-wide recipe changes.
